title: Assassin From the White Room
overview: Ayanokoji's second year begins with a new threat from the White Room and a new special test.

title: Contract and Payment
overview: Ayanokoji and Horikita's quest for a partner for Sudo brings them to a first-year with unusual demands.

title: Determination of a Leader
overview: Class 2-D continues its negotiations with Class 1-D as the state of the field becomes more clear.

title: To Whom the Blade Turns
overview: Negotiations with Hosen come to a head with little time left before the end of the special test.

title: The 20 Million Man
overview: Ayanokoji manages to avoid a scheme set up by the new first-year students that could have led to expulsion. However, the results of his special exam throw Class 2-D into an uproar, with some even suspecting foul play. Ayanokoji ends up being pressed by his classmates...

title: A Turbulent Battle for Recruitment
overview: The uninhabited island survival exam for this year has been announced. It will last for two weeks, and the island will be larger than last year's. Additionally, students from all grade levels will compete against each other. Before the exam begins, a four-week period is provided for forming groups, sparking a fierce competition among all classes to recruit members.

title: Plotting
overview: The first-years arrange a super team for the upcoming test, but bad blood runs deep between Utomiya and Hosen.

title: The Subject of the Dragons' Gaze
overview: With the test approaching, Ayanokoji attracts attention from third-years and Ryuen.

title: A Disquieting Beginning
overview: The deserted island special test finally begins.

title: Love Uncommunicated
overview: The special test begins in earnest as Ayanokoji takes the state of the game and aids a struggling teammate.

title: Connection
overview: After hearing the watch alarm, Ayanokoji and the others discover the first students to withdraw.

title: After Vengeance
overview: Ayanokoji and Nanase's latest journey takes them over the mountains, where dramatic revelations are made.

title: Obscured by the Rain
overview: Amasawa confronts Ayanokoji and reveals her connection to the White Room.

title: The Extraordinary Prodigy
overview: The third-years make their move to try to dominate the test's top three slots.

title: Power and Will
overview: The first-years make a big move to take down solo-team stragglers... starting with Ayanokoji!

title: For a Desired Future
overview: While Amasawa delays Horikita, Ayanokoji arrives at the I2 area where a climactic showdown awaits.
